insights.claim: Kueue's 34 admission webhooks with Fail failure policy create a broad blast radius: webhook service unavailability blocks workload creation across 7 job frameworks, core Pods, Deployments, and StatefulSets cluster-wide.
insights.reasoning: All 34 webhooks use failurePolicy: Fail. The mutating webhooks intercept CREATE on pods, jobs, deployments, statefulsets, and all supported ML training job types. The validating webhooks intercept CREATE and UPDATE on the same resources. A single-replica controller-manager (deployment.yaml shows replicas: 1) serving all webhooks through one Service means any controller-manager outage blocks workload creation across the cluster.

insights.claim: The two-tier operator pattern (operator manages operand deployment) creates a dependency chain where the operator must be healthy before the Kueue controller can be created or updated, but the operator itself runs at system-cluster-critical priority with 2 replicas while the operand runs as a single replica.
insights.reasoning: The operator deployment (deploy/07_deployment.yaml) runs 2 replicas at system-cluster-critical priority, while the controller-manager deployment it creates (bindata/assets/kueue-operator/deployment.yaml) runs only 1 replica. The operator is more available than the operand it manages, which is architecturally sound for reconciliation but leaves the webhook-serving operand as a single point of failure.

insights.claim: The operator binary is built with -tags strictfipsruntime on the Red Hat Go builder, enforcing FIPS-validated cryptography at runtime when running on FIPS-enabled systems. The operand (upstream Kueue) FIPS status depends on its own build process and is not controlled by this operator repository.
insights.reasoning: Makefile line 12 sets GO_BUILD_FLAGS :=-tags strictfipsruntime for the operator binary. The Dockerfile uses the Red Hat openshift-golang-builder which enables CGO by default for dynamic linking with OpenSSL. However, the operand image is injected via RELATED_IMAGE_OPERAND_IMAGE env var and its FIPS posture is outside this repository's control.
